title: CVE-2026-59243: Apache Airflow FAB provider: FAB auth manager: JWT signature verification disabled by default for Azure AD OAuth (`verify_signature` defaults to `False`)
description:

- Apache Airflow FAB provider (apache-airflow-providers-fab) before 3.7.3
